title: The quadratic Taylor term converges to the diffusion Hessian contraction
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: The quadratic Taylor term converges to the diffusion Hessian contraction. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: Construct a Euclidean process from completed Itô rows. Suppose it stays in compact K almost surely throughout the horizon and the scalar test is twice continuously Fréchet differentiable at every point of K. The dyadic sum of half the Hessian applied twice to the actual increment converges in measure to the time integral of half the sum of the Hessian on the diffusion columns.
